name: ASRV.Gamma

args.name: submodel
args.description: The substitution model or mixture whose rates vary among sites

args.name: n
args.description: The number of equal-probability Gamma categories

args.name: alpha
args.description: The shape parameter for the Gamma distribution

title: The Gamma rate heterogeneity model
description:
Models differences in evolutionary rate among sites using a Gamma distribution with mean 1. Smaller values of alpha give greater rate variation; larger values give more nearly equal rates.

The distribution is divided into n equal-probability categories, each represented by its conditional mean. When applied to an existing mixture, each component is combined with each rate category.

citation.title: Maximum likelihood phylogenetic estimation from DNA sequences with variable rates over sites: approximate methods
